name: epistemic-protocols
description: A domain-free metalanguage of structured types and morphisms that moves the cognitive load of human-AI collaboration from recall to recognition: unknowns are elicited into utterance and answered or recognized where they bind, before local misalignment hardens into system-wide rework.

plugins.name: katalepsis
plugins.description: Check that something in play — code, a document, a result — is actually understood, step by step — /grasp (κατάληψις: a grasping firmly)

plugins.name: aitesis
plugins.description: Collect what the AI can reach on its own, hand back the rest as the user's unknown — /inquire (αἴτησις: a requesting)

plugins.name: analogia
plugins.description: Check what an analogy or framework actually supports about a case in play — /ground (ἀναλογία: a proportion)

plugins.name: periagoge
plugins.description: Align concrete cases first, then name what they share — /induce (περιαγωγή: turning-around)

plugins.name: euporia
plugins.description: Find the decisions a rough intent turns on, traced from your own material and the domain's usual decisions — /elicit (εὐπορία: way through)

plugins.name: merismos
plugins.description: Apportion an autonomous goal into coarse execution units and derive each unit's completion conditions — /apportion (μερισμός: an apportionment)

plugins.name: epharmoge
plugins.description: Check that a correct result fits your actual situation — /contextualize (ἐφαρμογή: an application)

plugins.name: elenchus
plugins.description: Challenge the context you are about to act on, before acting — /sublate (ἔλεγχος: cross-examination)

plugins.name: horismos
plugins.description: See what a task needs decided, then choose what to keep or entrust — /bound (ὁρισμός: a bounding)

plugins.name: epistemic-cooperative
plugins.description: Utility skills layered on top of the core protocols; each utility skill's own SKILL.md carries its contract.

plugins.name: anamnesis
plugins.description: Resolve vague recall into recognized context — one session, or a line of work, topic, or settled concept across several — /recollect (ἀνάμνησις: recollection)

plugins.name: hyphegesis
plugins.description: Settle how work with several lines of thinking runs before starting it — /conduct (ὑφήγησις: a leading-the-way)

plugins.name: proplasma
plugins.description: Compare throwaway probes of candidate directions before committing to one — /preview (πρόπλασμα: a preliminary clay model)

plugins.name: hypotyposis
plugins.description: Discover a form by marking what does not fit on concrete sketches until one is recognized — /sketch (ὑποτύπωσις: an outline, a first sketch)

plugins.name: heuresis
plugins.description: Widen an empty or prematurely narrowed field of ideas before choosing — /ideate (εὕρεσις: finding/invention)

plugins.name: route
plugins.description: Route the accumulated session context to the core protocol whose deficit it shows — /route (per-prompt hook directive)
